newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fortis to pay more than 8 bln bfr for ASLK stake.
newsitem.headline: Fortis to pay more than 8 bln bfr for ASLK stake.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Friday Belgian-Dutch banking and insurance group Fortis would pay more than eight billion francs for a fresh stake in bank ASLK-CGER.

"If we apply the 1993 agreement (the price) would be about eight billion Belgian francs. It will be more because ASLK-CGER have since increased in value and the stock market has risen greatly," Maystadt said after the weekly cabinet meeting.
At the meeting the government agreed to sell 14.9 percent in ASLK-CGER on the stock market this autumn. A further 9.8 percent would be sold to Fortis.
Fortis already owns 49.9 percent of ASLK following an initial part-privatisation in 1993.
Belgium at that time negotiated a put option to sell Fortis 9.8 percent stake at a preset price.
Maystadt said the price had been renegotiated and the final sum would depend on the price ASLK shares would be floated at.
"The price Fortis pays cannot be less than the price set during the bourse listing," he said. He gave no details.
He said the money raised from the sale and bourse listing would be used exclusively to re-pay part of Belgium's huge debt.
Belgium has set itself a target of reducing its debt to 127 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) by the end of 1997.
Because Belgium's public finances were better than expected in 1997, not all of the ASLK-CGER funds would be needed to meet that goal. Maystadt said, "It could be used next year."
To facilitate the listing it had been necessary to restructure ASLK -- currently two separate companies representing banking and insurance activities.
ASLK Insurance would become a subsidiary of the listed ASLK Bank.
The sale and listing will cut Belgium's stake in ASLK to 25.1 percent.
Maystadt said that although the state would only hold 0.1 percent of shares in the restructured ASLK Insurance -- a so-called golden share -- it would have a 25.1 percent blocking vote.
